representation: V1.1: three distributed ~550-word windows per document

v1_3_rule.name: background-centered V1.2 similarity
v1_3_rule.background_definition: Frozen development bank of 58 authors / 635 genuine documents. For a new target profile, score every frozen background document against that target profile using frozen V1.2, then take the median.
v1_3_rule.target_author_overlap_rule: The target-profile author must not contribute documents to the background median. External validation authors are excluded from the development bank by cohort firewall. For development diagnostics, exclude the target author's entire document set.
v1_3_rule.background_weighting: Document-weighted median, matching the development experiment.

operating_threshold.classification_rule: same-author-compatible if S_v1_3 >= threshold; otherwise stylistically unusual
operating_threshold.selection_method: Median of the five balanced-accuracy-optimal thresholds learned on training authors only in whole-author CV.

validation_rule: Do not modify this scoring rule, background-bank membership, base V1.2 calibration, or operating threshold after inspecting the next V1.3 external-validation cohort.
phase1_v1_2_external_usage: The prior 20-author V1.2 Phase 1 external cohort was used only to motivate the V1.3 research hypothesis. It must not be used to estimate V1.3 parameters or to claim independent V1.3 validation.
interpretation_warning: Experimental stylistic-consistency score; not a probability or proof of authorship, non-authorship, AI use, plagiarism, cheating, or misconduct.
